sources.snippet: DarijaDZ DarijaDZ is a large-scale corpus of user-generated text collected from Algerian YouTube channels. The corpus contains approximately 1.4 million comment documents and 14.7 million word-level tokens, with content written primarily in Algerian Darija script alongside Latin/Arabizi writing and mixed-script content.
